text:
marta: Heads-up: since the KMS proxy change in prod last night we've seen ~40% increase in keystore latency and a few GPU warmup failures. Observed in eu-west and us-west.
darren: grafana link? /cc @shiv
marta: grafana: https://grafana.redwood/prod/d/keystore?panel=latency
short log excerpt:
```
2026-03-19T22:11:05Z keystore-proxy timeout=120ms err=slow-auth
2026-03-19T22:11:06Z node-provision id=i-abc svc=gpu-warmup error=keystore_timeout
```
ops-bot: alert: keystore-proxy latency > 80ms for 15m in eu-west
shiv: Is this the new privatelink setup or the circuit-breaker tweak? We pushed the mTLS updates.
marta: privatelink + stricter firewall egress rules in front of keystore. It looks like TCP handshake + TLS renegotiation doubled RTOs. Also noticed audit logs are spiking -> extra S3 writes.
aisha: Cost note: audit S3 put requests are up ~3x this morning. If we keep the retry behavior we'll pay a lot. Possibly switch to batch flush for audit logs.
darren: Immediate mitigations: 1) loosen egress NACL for keystore healthcheck CIDR 2) increase keystore proxy pool size 3) add a short local token cache on node agent.
ron: local cache sounds safest. We already have a lightweight LRU in agent but TTL was 0 after the policy change. Can bump to 30s-60s.
marta: can we do cache + temporary egress tweak now? I can push a short canary to us-west.
shiv: I'll approve egress change but need IAM sign-off. @aisha can you confirm audit retention doesn't violate compliance if we batch?
aisha: Batching audit writes is allowed for up to 5min buffer as long as integrity is preserved. We'll add a signed checksum per batch.
darren: Patch for agent to enable cache 60s ready in staging: 
```
# agent config
keystore_cache_ttl: 60
keystore_retry: 2
```
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy agent v2.3.1 to us-west started
marta: :thumbsup: monitoring steady after canary, latency down ~25% in us-west. eu-west still noisy.
shiv: For eu-west we should check privatelink endpoints count. Maybe hit ELB connection limits. I'll profile.
ron: Also we should consider retry backoff jitter to avoid thundering herd during keystore flaps.
marta: Next steps: (1) keep canary for 1h (2) apply short egress rule for keystore health CIDR (3) schedule keystore proxy scaling tomorrow (4) follow up on audit batching design doc. I'll create a follow-up thread in #eng-security.
aisha: I'll draft the audit-batching doc and include checksum pattern + retention.
shiv: Thanks. Filing a ticket for keystore proxy autoscale + connection pool tuning. Ticket: INFRA-4312
marta: closing the loop: last check 1799998940 - warmup errors down to baseline. Leaving open until scaling planned.
